verdict.rationale: Zep provides explicit deletion controls: deleting a User deletes all Threads/artifacts in one API call for Right-to-be-Forgotten compliance, and granular edge/node deletion APIs allow fine-grained data removal. This is backed by documented API calls (client.graph.edge.delete) and explicit RTBF/privacy-regulation framing. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of deletion behavior and no mention of data retention policies/TTLs or export-before-delete options.
